profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Resourceful and detail-oriented software engineer proficient in modern web development, specializing in React.js, TypeScript/JavaScript, and TestCafe. I excel in collaborative Agile Software Development and Issue-Driven Project Management, enabling quick and successful delivery of projects. As an Eagle Scout, I learned responsibility and leadership. I view every opportunity as a platform for learning and growth and consistently commit to excellence in all endeavors.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Volunteer platform that connects passionate volunteers with charitable organizations across the Hawaiian Islands, building our local community. 
- Developed a responsive frontend in React and Tailwind, improving accessibility and engagement
- Integrated RESTful APIs and backend support to enable real-time event filtering and dynamic user dashboards using Next.js and MongoDB
- Designed an internal admin dashboard that streamlined content management, helping other teams operate faster and more efficiently
- Led the development of site gamification to increase volunteer engagement and retention

projects.title: Noble
projects.description: Noble is dedicated to providing HIANG service members with reliable and anonymous health information. It features a Frequently Asked Questions page full of answers that are simple to search and sort through. Users can talk with an AI chatbot knowledgeable about Air Force Medical Standards and procedures on the Question Compass page. If you didn’t find an answer, ask an anonymous question in the Ask A Doc Page. Noble aims to enhance a user’s understanding of their health and provide a supportive platform for addressing medical concerns securely and privately.

projects.title: Sustainer
projects.description:
Tracks reusable containers and encourages users with monetary incentives for returning them.
- Designed and implemented a scalable database architecture using MongoDB to support real-time container tracking and user reward data
- Developed QR code scanning, generation, and validation for transactions
- Built an admin dashboard to manage container inventory and monitor user return activity
- Wrote automated unit tests to ensure front-end and back-end reliability using TestCafe
